EN:
Welcome to the Kingdoms, adventurer! Use the [BLUE]left stick[] (or the d-pad) to move around.

Press [BLUE]+[] for the game menu, [BLUE]-[] for your character, and click the [BLUE]left stick[] to open the map.
PT:
Bem-vindo aos Reinos, aventureiro! Use o [BLUE]analógico esquerdo[] (ou o direcional) para andar.

Aperte [BLUE]+[] para o menu do jogo, [BLUE]-[] para o seu personagem, e clique o [BLUE]analógico esquerdo[] para abrir o mapa.

EN:
Press [BLUE]A[] to face and attack the closest enemy in weapon range; [BLUE]hold A[] to keep attacking at your weapon's speed.

Skills go on [BLUE]ZL or ZR + A, B, X or Y[] (eight in total).
PT:

As habilidades ficam em [BLUE]ZL ou ZR + A, B, X ou Y[] (oito no total).

EN:
Remember when they taught you to never talk to strangers nor pick up things you find on the ground? Well, turns out in this game you can, and should.

Get close to people or items, and an icon [BLUE]will appear on the upper right[] corner of the screen. Press [BLUE]X[] to interact.

Chegue perto de pessoas ou objetos e um ícone [BLUE]aparece no canto superior direito[] da tela. Aperte [BLUE]X[] para interagir.
